title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Straw Grapefruit / Straw Dragonfruit Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This dual pack offers two fresh takes on Strawberry in one setup. Straw’ Grapefruit adds a sharp citrus edge to brighten the softer, summery sweetness of Strawberry, while Straw’ Dragonfruit layers in the tropical fruit’s smooth, exotic flavour for a rounder finish. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, each pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can load both flavours together and switch at the device selector. The plug-in system keeps handling simple and tidy, with no need for manual refilling or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid deliver clear flavour, consistent MTL vapour and rapid nicotine relief from either refill. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
